summary: tracing-appender rolls and names the daily file by the UTC date, but the module doc, CHANGELOG and design-review promised local-time days; in JST a morning failure is in the previous day's file
harness_idea: A test that builds the appender in a temp dir and asserts the file is named for OffsetDateTime::now_utc().date(), so docs cannot claim local time

summary: The error/unhandledrejection listeners neither dedupe nor rate-limit, so an error thrown every frame writes thousands of identical ERROR lines into the kept files
harness_idea: Dispatch 1000 identical ErrorEvents in an e2e test and assert the mock log_ui_error received a bounded number of calls

summary: log_ui_error writes the message unescaped, so an error quoting page or feed text with newlines can forge lines that look like real ERROR job{...} records
harness_idea: A Rust test that a multi-line message yields one record whose continuation lines are indented

summary: With RUST_LOG set, the CLI's tracing init installs LogTracer first, so serve's StderrLogger silently fails to install and its warning lines change format and level
harness_idea: A CLI test that runs serve, or an op that warns, with and without RUST_LOG and asserts the stderr line shape

summary: The committed license list still named tauri-plugin-log and lacked tracing-subscriber/tracing-appender after the dependency change
harness_idea: A CI step that runs mise run licenses whenever Cargo.lock changes and fails on git diff --exit-code THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES

summary: Nothing tested that a log:: call inside a job span reaches the file with the span fields; it relies on tracing-subscriber's default tracing-log feature
harness_idea: The added test: init into a temp dir, log::warn! inside info_span!(job), assert the file has job{id=7 kind=translate} and the message

summary: At startup the appender prunes to max_files - 1 counting today's existing file, so after a same-day restart 13 dated files remain, not 14
harness_idea: Pre-create 14 dated files including today's, build the appender, count what remains

id: , U+2028 or U+0085 in a quoted message still starts a visual line in the log
commit: A test that every line break a viewer shows (

id: , U+2028, U+0085) comes out as an indented continuation

summary: The dedupe remembered only the last message, so alternating errors or one with a counter in its text still flooded the log
harness_idea: A test that alternating and varying messages are logged a bounded number of times

summary: The dedupe and the newline indenting were marked fixed without the tests their harness ideas named
harness_idea: When a finding is marked fixed, the harness idea written beside it is implemented in the same commit

summary: The bridge test called the real init, which reads RUST_LOG, so a developer with RUST_LOG=error got a failure
harness_idea: Run the test suite under a hostile RUST_LOG in CI once

summary: The bridge test installed the production panic hook for the whole test binary, adding a forced backtrace to every later test failure
harness_idea: A test must not install process-global hooks; split the global side effects from what is under test

summary: The temp dir was named by pid only and the test read the first file in it, so a leftover dir could make it read a stale file
harness_idea: A lint against temp paths named by pid alone in tests

summary: The G38 paragraph still said the log plugin is registered in setup after tauri-plugin-log was removed
harness_idea: Grep docs (outside dated records) for the names of dependencies removed from Cargo.toml

summary: Two trailing blank lines after the new dev-dependencies block
